mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.title AS title, i.file_data AS imgUrl, a.session AS session, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.created_at AS auctionDate, string_agg(t.tag_name, ', ') AS tags FROM auction a JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key JOIN ( SELECT prod_key, MIN(reg_date) AS min_regdate FROM file GROUP BY prod_key ) fi ON p.prod_key = fi.prod_key JOIN file i ON i.prod_key = fi.prod_key AND i.reg_date = fi.min_regdate LEFT JOIN auctiontag at ON a.auction_id = at.auc_key LEFT JOIN tag t ON at.tag_key = t.tag_key WHERE a.host_id = #{loginId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.title, i.file_data, a.session, a.created_at, a.start_time, a.end_time

SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.session, a.title, u.user_name AS auctioneer, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, COUNT(p.prod_key) AS itemCount FROM auction a LEFT JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.login_id WHERE a.auction_id = #{auctionId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.session, a.title, u.user_name, a.start_time, a.end_time;

SELECT p.prod_key AS prodId, p.prod_name AS prodName, ( SELECT f.file_data FROM file f WHERE f.prod_key = p.prod_key LIMIT 1 ) AS image, p.final_price AS price, u.nickname AS winner FROM product p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.winner_id = u.user_key WHERE p.auc_key = #{auctionId};

SELECT p.prod_key AS prodId, p.prod_name AS prodName, ( SELECT f.file_data FROM file f WHERE f.prod_key = p.prod_key LIMIT 1 ) AS image, p.final_price AS price FROM product p WHERE p.winner_id = #{userKey} ORDER BY p.prod_key DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction(host_id, created_at, title, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{hostId}, NOW(), #{title}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, '진행중')
